summary: Greif, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the amendment and restatement of its existing receivables financing facility. On May 11, 2026, certain U.S. subsidiaries entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Transfer and Administration Agreement with PNC Bank, reducing the facility size from $275 million to $200 million. The facility involves the sale of receivables to Greif Receivables Funding LLC, a consolidated but separate legal entity. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility, not a special situation like a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms apply.
